title: Uncertainty and Evidence-Lineage Ablation
question: Does explicit uncertainty representation and traceable evidence lineage improve diagnostic reasoning and decisions compared with an otherwise equivalent framework?
claim_under_test: Explicit uncertainty and traceable evidence lineage improve diagnostic framework behavior under identifiable conditions.
objective: Isolate uncertainty and evidence-lineage effects with blinded, repeated diagnostic runs.
non_objectives: Validate Framework Engineering as a whole
Treat provider agreement as human validation
assumptions: Case materials are sufficient to test the targeted conditions
procedure: Freeze and hash framework and case artifacts.
Run the 27-run minimum matrix in isolated contexts.
replication_plan: Three trials per framework/case; preferred replication across two provider families.
falsification_conditions: Baseline is equivalent or better after controlling for length.
Lineage is decorative or increases harm.
inconclusive_conditions: Execution does not meet the minimum matrix or a stop condition compromises isolation.
